SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Confidential REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & File REGISTRY. No. D 4028 Louza Station, Date 17/9/32 Date 15th Sept. 1932.）

Subject (in full) Report on inquiries re attached anonymous letter concerning hotels and opium.

Made by D.I. White Forwarded by Jen M. Adams Cl.

Sir,

Regarding the information contained in attached anonymous letter inquiries by the undersigned with D.S.I. Soo Zang Sung and C.D.C.230 ascertained the following:-

Re Grand Hotel, 20 Thibet Road.

Room 515 was engaged on 2-8-32 by one Kying Zien Kyi (經全記) native of Szechuen, proprietor of a shop at ? Chekiang Road near Chefoo Road. This person still occupies the room, is of a respectable business class, has no connection with opium and is not an opium smoker. Attends his shop regularly and is early to bed every night.

Room 520 was engaged on 7-7-32 by one Dzung Zu Sai (鄭樹珊), President of the Woosung Chamber of Commerce. He still occupies the room and is reported to be in possession of an opium smoking set.

Room 319 was engaged by one Waung Ts Ling (汪子林) and his wife. Waung is a detective attached to the Sing Song Section of the French Police. His wife is an opium smoker and they were in possession of an opium smoking outfit. They vacated the room on 8-9-32.

Room 323 was engaged on 31-8-32 by one Zung Tsuh Nyau (陳哲克), an ex-detective of the French Police and now employed by a foreign company. This person attends his employment regularly and is not an opium user. Vacated the room on 7-9-32.

Regarding the sale of opium in certain hotels there is no doubt this refers to certain boys employed on the premises who are in possession of opium smoking outfits and rent them privately to room-occupants. In other cases the occupants

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C. & 档案登记处。编号 D 4028 老闸捕房，日期 1932年9月17日 日期 1932年9月15日。）

主题（全称） 关于所附涉及旅馆与鸦片的匿名信之查询报告。

由 督察怀特（D.I. White）呈报 经由 詹·M·亚当斯（Jen M. Adams）文员转发。

先生，

关于所附匿名信中所载信息，经卑职会同副督察苏藏松（Soo Zang Sung，音译）及刑事侦缉科第230号探员（C.D.C.230）查询，查明如下：

关于西藏路20号大华饭店（Grand Hotel）。

515号房间于1932年8月2日由一名叫经全记（Kying Zien Kyi）的人租用，系四川人，为浙江路靠近芝罘路（Chefoo Road）附近某商铺的店主。此人目前仍占用该房间，属体面的商界人士，与鸦片无关，亦非鸦片吸食者。定期前往其店铺，每晚早睡。

520号房间于1932年7月7日由吴淞商会会长郑树珊（Dzung Zu Sai）租用。他目前仍占用该房间，据报拥有一套鸦片烟具。

319号房间由汪子林（Waung Ts Ling）及其妻子租用。汪是法国警察署唱歌舞女组（Sing Song Section）的一名侦探。其妻为鸦片吸食者，他们拥有一套鸦片烟具。他们于1932年9月8日退租该房间。

323号房间于1932年8月31日由陈哲克（Zung Tsuh Nyau）租用，系法国警察署前侦探，现受雇于一家外商公司。此人定期上班，不吸食鸦片。于1932年9月7日退租该房间。

关于某些旅馆内出售鸦片一事，无疑是指受雇于场所内的某些茶房（boys），他们拥有鸦片烟具，并私下出租给住客。在其他情况下，部分房间的住客

of some rooms are in possession of smoking outfits. This will
be seen in reference to Icuza P.I.R.s 1829/32 and 1832/32. In
the first case three arrests were effected on 28-7-32 in room
104, Great Eastern Hotel:- one charged with conducting opium
smoking, one charged with opium smoking, both convicted. The
third accused was the room-boy who was charged with aiding and
abetting in conducting opium smoking and sentenced to 15 days'

The second case refers to the arrest of one male Chinese

for being in possession of an opium smoking set and opium. Fined

在第一起案件中，1932年7月28日在大东旅馆（Great Eastern Hotel）104号房间实施了三起逮捕：一人被控开设鸦片烟馆，一人被控吸食鸦片，两人均被判有罪。
第三名被告是该房间的茶房，被控协助及教唆开设鸦片烟馆，判处监禁15天。

第二起案件涉及1932年7月28日在湖北路（Hoopeh Road）罗仲旅社（Loh Jung Lodging House，音译）51号房间逮捕一名中国男子，罪名是持有鸦片烟具及鸦片。1932年7月29日被罚款80.00元或监禁80天。没有任何信息可以表明除上述提及者外，有任何其他旅馆进行鸦片销售。

关于指控称已批准任何人出售鸦片的说法，这完全毫无根据。

Major K.M. Bourne,
Foochow Road Police Station.

Sir,
We convey to you our appreciation for the
gradual decrease of criminal cases since your
assumption of duty as D.C. (Crime), but there
remains one more thing to be regretted, that of
opium smoking and gambling in Chinese hotels. It
seems that the opium syndicate who operated in the
French Concession have transferred their sphere of
activities into the Settlement. If you doubt my
words, you just have to cause enquiries to be made.

The Grand Hotel (Rooms) 515, 520, 323, 319.

Opium is also sold in the Great Grand China Hotel,
Great Shanghai Hotel, China Hotel, Zungchow Hotel,
Wu Koong Lodging House, Chia Loh Hotel, Far Eastern
Hotel, etc., and it is said that permission for the
sale of such a contraband has been secured from the
Police by Tu Yueh Sung.

CONFIDENTIAL
D.D.O A

Through proper channel
from C. Detective Section
after preliminary investigation
of your work.

（印：RECD. COMMISSIONERS : SEP 6 1932 (CRIME BRANCH)）

Wong Shou-ding (王孝亭),
Merchants' Union.

For Dictn L.

先生，
我们对您自担任刑事科副主任（D.C. (Crime)）以来刑事案件逐渐减少表示赞赏，但仍有一件事令人遗憾，即中国旅馆内的鸦片吸食和赌博。似乎曾在法租界活动的鸦片辛迪加已将其活动范围转移至公共租界。如果您怀疑我的话，只需派人调查即可。

大华饭店（房间）515、520、323、319。

大中华大饭店（Great Grand China Hotel）、大上海饭店（Great Shanghai Hotel）、中国饭店（China Hotel）、中州饭店（Zungchow Hotel，音译）、武宫旅社（Wu Koong Lodging House，音译）、嘉乐饭店（Chia Loh Hotel，音译）、远东饭店（Far Eastern Hotel）等也出售鸦片，据说杜月笙已从警方获得出售此类违禁品的许可。

机密

来自刑事侦缉科

商民协会。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Special Branch B.2.
Date September 12, 1932.

Subject (in full) Communist and Pro-communist literature found at No.7 Tsong
Sing Faung, Ward Road, September 7, 1932.

Made by D.S. Moore. Forwarded by [签名]

Nos.1, 2 and 3 as quoted on the attached list are
communistic. Here follows an outline of the contents of No.3.
Contains (1) an outline of the Constitution of the
Soviet Republic of China (2) the Labour law and Land Regulations
of the Soviet Government (3) Resolutions passed relating to the
Chinese Red Army (4) the Soviet economic policy (5) Resolutions
passed relating to a minority of certain peoples in China (such
as Mongolians, Thibetans, Mohamedans etc.)

The following is a review of Nos.4, 5 and 6 :-
Pro-Communistic. The character of these books is
mainly of a narrative and discursive nature touching on the
subjects of revolution, economics and materialism.
No.4. Eulogizes the economic and social policies of
Soviet Russia.
No.5. Deals with theories which consider the facts of the
universe to be explained by the existence and nature of matter.
No.6. Is a translation of a book entitled "Lenin
Kampfende matuelist" (Lenin - Struggling materialists)
written by a German author named A. Deborin - (Practically on the
same line as No.5 above.

[签名：W.B. Moore]
D. S.

报告

日期 1932年9月12日。

主题（全称） 1932年9月7日在华德路宗兴坊7号发现的共产主义及亲共文献。

由 穆尔副督察（D.S. Moore）制作。由 [签名] 转发。

附件清单中引用的第1、2和3号物品属于共产主义性质。以下是第3号物品的内容概要。
包含 (1) 中华苏维埃共和国宪法大纲 (2) 苏维埃政府的劳动法及土地条例 (3) 有关中国红军的决议 (4) 苏维埃经济政策 (5) 有关中国某些少数民族（如蒙古人、西藏人、穆斯林等）的决议。

以下是对第4、5和6号物品的综述：
亲共性质。这些书籍的性质主要是叙述性和论述性的，涉及革命、经济学和唯物主义主题。
第4号。颂扬苏俄的经济和社会政策。
第5号。探讨认为宇宙事实可由物质的存在和性质来解释的理论。
第6号。是一本名为《列宁 Kampfende matuelist》（列宁——斗争的唯物主义者）的书的译本，由一位名叫 A. Deborin 的德国作者撰写——（实际上与上述第5号内容大致相同。

[手写批注：中共]
[签名：W.B. Moore]

特别支部主管警官。
[签名：G.C. (Brown)]
知悉。
副总办 D
[签名：J.K. Givens]
特别支部主管
1932年9月12日。
